name: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 50ml | Korea
description:
COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 50ml | Korea

Gentle yet effective, COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser is designed for sensitive skin. This daily gel cleanser removes impurities without stripping, refines skin texture, and strengthens the skin barrier, leaving your skin clean, balanced, and luminous.

Key Features:

Daily Gentle Cleanser: Perfect for morning and night use, suitable for all skin types.

Key Ingredients: Tea Tree Oil and BHA soothe, clarify, and strengthen the skin.

pH Balanced: Maintains skin’s natural slightly acidic pH for optimal protection.

Skin-Friendly Formula: Hypoallergenic, dermatologist-tested, free from parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and cruelty-free.

Benefits: Cleanses deeply, refines skin texture, protects the skin barrier, and promotes clear, radiant skin.

Keep your skin fresh, balanced, and glowing every day with COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser 50ml.
